title: Television control experiment (30 subjects, 4 classes, 31 EEG ch)
description: EEG dataset from 30 healthy participants performing an ERP-based (P300) brain-computer interface task for controlling a television as a home appliance. A four-class visual oddball paradigm was presented on an LCD display, with target and non-target flashes recorded from 31 EEG channels at 500 Hz. Each subject completed training and online testing blocks with visual feedback, supporting research on BCI-based home appliance control and inter-subject transfer learning.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an actiCHamp (Brain Products) amplifier using 31 active electrodes placed according to the 10-20 system, sampled at 500 Hz with linked-mastoid reference. Visual flash stimuli with a 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony were presented on an LCD display in a four-class oddball paradigm. Each subject completed 50 training and 30 online testing blocks with visual feedback.
